BG_LIVING_WALL.title: Living Wall
BG_LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.description: Strange faces cover the walls. "Forget what you know," one says. "Change," says another. "Grow!" says the last.
BG_LIVING_WALL.pages.RESULT.description: The wall stops talking and lets you pass.
BG_THE_LIBRARY.title: The Library
BG_THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.description:
You come across an ornate building which appears abandoned.
A plaque that has been torn free from a wall is on the floor. It reads, [blue]"THE LIBRARY".[/blue]
Inside, you find countless rows of scrolls, manuscripts, and books.
You pick one and cozy yourself into a chair for some quiet time.
BG_THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.options.REA: [green]Choose 1 of 5 cards to add to your deck.[/green]
BG_THE_LIBRARY.pages.READ.description: One of the books holds something worth keeping.
BG_THE_LIBRARY.pages.LEAVE.description: You leave the books to gather dust.
BG_GOLDEN_IDOL.title: Ancient Temple
BG_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.INITIAL.description:
You come across an ancient temple with a [gold]shining treasure[/gold] sitting peacefully inside. It looks incredibly valuable.

You sure don't see any traps nearby.
BG_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.INITIAL.options.TAK: [green]Obtain a relic.[/green] [red]Trigger a trap and take 1 damage.[/red]
BG_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.TAKE.description: As you grab the relic, a boulder smashes through the ceiling. You dive aside, but not quite fast enough.
BG_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.LEAVE.description: It looks too good to be true. You move on.
BG_GOLDEN_WING.title: Wing Statue
BG_GOLDEN_WING.pages.INITIAL.description:
Among the stone and boulders, you notice an intricate large blue statue resembling a wing.
You find [gold]gold[/gold] spilling from its cracks. Maybe there is more inside...
BG_GOLDEN_WING.pages.INITIAL.options.PRA: [green]Remove a card from your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 2 HP.[/red]
BG_GOLDEN_WING.pages.PRAY.description: Pain flares through you, and with it, something you no longer need.
BG_GOLDEN_WING.pages.DESTROY.description: You smash the statue and pocket the gold inside.
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.title: Bonfire Spirits
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.INITIAL.descrip: You happen upon a group of what looks like [purple]purple fire spirits[/purple] dancing around a large bonfire.
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.INITIAL.options: Remove a card from your deck. Receive a reward based on its rarity: an Uncommon [green]heals 3 HP[/green], a Rare [green]heals you to full[/green], a Curse [red]costs 1 HP[/red].
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.COMMON.descript: The spirits accept your offering politely.
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.UNCOMMON.descri: The spirits are pleased. Warmth washes over you.
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.RARE.descriptio: The spirits are delighted! You feel completely restored.
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.CURSE.descripti: The bonfire explodes in your face!
BG_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.LEAVE.descripti: You leave the spirits to their dance.
BG_TRANSMOGRIFIER.title: Transmogrifier
BG_TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.INITIAL.descript: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
BG_TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.PRAY.description: Your card twists into something new.
BG_TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.SACRIFICE.descri: Your cards twist into something new, and something dark slips in with them.
BG_THE_CLERIC.title: The Cleric
BG_THE_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.description:
A strange blue humanoid with a golden helm(?) approaches you with a huge smile.
"Hello friend! I am [blue]Cleric![/blue] Are you interested in my services?!" the creature shouts, loudly.
BG_THE_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.options.PURI: [gold]3 Gold:[/gold] [green]Remove a card from your deck.[/green]
BG_THE_CLERIC.pages.HEAL.description: A warm golden light envelops you.
BG_THE_CLERIC.pages.PRAYER.description: The Cleric blesses one of your cards.
BG_THE_CLERIC.pages.LEAVE.description: You don't trust this "Cleric", so you leave.
BG_UPGRADE_SHRINE.title: Upgrade Shrine
BG_UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL.descript: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
BG_UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.description: You feel a surge of power.
BG_UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.SACRIFICE.descri: The shrine drinks your blood, and power flows through you.
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.title: Wheel of Change
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
You come upon a dapper looking, cheery gremlin.
"It's time to spin the wheel! Are you R E A D Y ? Of course you are!"
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.INITIAL.options: Roll the die: [blue]1[/blue] gain 4 Gold, [blue]2[/blue] a relic, [blue]3[/blue] heal to full, [blue]4[/blue] a Curse, [blue]5[/blue] remove a card, [blue]6[/blue] lose 2 HP.
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.PRIZE_1.descrip: Gold coins rain from the wheel!
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.PRIZE_2.descrip: The gremlin hands you a relic.
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.PRIZE_4.descrip: The gremlin cackles. Something feels wrong.
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.PRIZE_5.descrip: The wheel takes something from you that you didn't need.
BG_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.PRIZE_6.descrip: The wheel flies off and hits you in the face.
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.title: Ominous Forge
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.pages.INITIAL.descripti: You duck into a small hut. Inside, you find what appears to be a forge. The smithing tools are covered with dust, yet a fire roars inside the furnace. You feel on edge...
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.pages.INITIAL.options.R: [green]Obtain a relic.[/green] Roll the die: on a [blue]1-3[/blue], [red]gain a Curse.[/red]
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.pages.FORGE.description: You burn yourself, but the work is good.
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.pages.LUCKY.description: You found a relic, and nothing else.
BG_OMINOUS_FORGE.pages.UNLUCKY.descripti: You found a relic, but something cursed came with it.
BG_LAB.title: Lab
BG_LAB.pages.INITIAL.description:
You find yourself in a room filled with racks of test tubes, beakers, flasks, forceps, pinch clamps, stirring rods, tongs, goggles, funnels, pipets, cylinders, condensers, and even a rare spiral tube of glass.

Why do you know the name of all these tools? It doesn't matter, you take a look around.
BG_LAB.pages.INITIAL.options.SEARCH.desc: [green]Gain a potion.[/green] Roll the die: on a [blue]4-6[/blue], [green]gain another.[/green]
BG_LAB.pages.SEARCH.description: You pocket what you can carry.
BG_BIG_FISH.title: Big Fish
BG_BIG_FISH.pages.INITIAL.description:
As you make your way down a long corridor you see a [gold]banana,[/gold] a [gold]donut,[/gold] and a [gold]box[/gold] floating about. No... upon closer inspection they are tied to strings coming from holes in the ceiling. There is a quiet cackling from above as you approach the objects.
What do you do?
BG_BIG_FISH.pages.INITIAL.options.RESTRA: [green]Remove a starter Strike from your deck.[/green]
BG_BIG_FISH.pages.DONUT.description: You eat the donut. It really hits the spot!
BG_BIG_FISH.pages.BOX.description: You grab the box. Inside is a relic, and something unpleasant.
BG_BIG_FISH.pages.RESTRAINT.description: You decline, feeling lighter for it.
BG_SCRAP_OOZE.title: Scrap Ooze
BG_SCRAP_OOZE.pages.INITIAL.description: As you walk into the room you hear a gurgling and the grinding of metals. Before you is a slime-like creature that ate too much scrap for its own good. From the center of the creature you see glints of strange light, perhaps something magical? It looks like you can get some [gold]treasure[/gold] if you just reach inside its... opening. However, the acid and sharp objects may [red]hurt.[/red]
BG_SCRAP_OOZE.pages.INITIAL.options.REAC: [red]Lose 1 HP.[/red] Roll the die: [blue]1-2[/blue] nothing, [blue]3-4[/blue] [green]2 Gold[/green], [blue]5-6[/blue] [green]a relic[/green].
BG_SCRAP_OOZE.pages.GOLD.description: You pull out a handful of gold.
BG_SCRAP_OOZE.pages.NOTHING.description: The acid burns, and you come up empty-handed.
BG_WORLD_OF_GOOP.title: World of Goop
BG_WORLD_OF_GOOP.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
You fall into a puddle.
IT'S MADE OF [green]SLIME GOOP!![/green]
Frantically, you claw yourself out over several minutes as you feel the goop starting to burn.
You can feel goop in your ears, goop in your nose, goop everywhere.

Climbing out, you notice that some of your [gold]gold[/gold] is missing. Looking back to the puddle you see your missing coins combined with [gold]gold[/gold] from unfortunate adventurers mixed together in the puddle.
BG_WORLD_OF_GOOP.pages.GATHER.descriptio: The goop stings, but you gather the gold.
BG_WORLD_OF_GOOP.pages.DEEPER.descriptio: You find a relic at the bottom, and something cursed.
BG_WORLD_OF_GOOP.pages.LEAVE_IT.descript: As you climb out, a coin slips away.
BG_DEAD_ADVENTURER.title: Dead Adventurer
BG_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.INITIAL.descrip: While searching the adventurer you are caught off guard!
BG_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.INITIAL.options: Roll the die: [blue]1-2[/blue] [red]fight an Elite[/red], [blue]3-4[/blue] [green]find 2 Gold[/green], [blue]5-6[/blue] [green]find a relic[/green].
BG_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.FIGHT.descripti: The monster that killed the adventurer returns!
BG_GOLDEN_SHRINE.title: Golden Shrine
BG_GOLDEN_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL.descripti: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to an ancient spirit.
BG_GOLDEN_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.description: A few coins fall from the shrine.
BG_GOLDEN_SHRINE.pages.DESECRATE.descrip: You pry the gold loose. You feel watched.
BG_CURSED_TOME.title: Cursed Tome
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.description:
In an abandoned temple, you find a giant book, open, riddled with [purple]cryptic writings.[/purple]

As you try to interpret the elaborate script, it begins to [blue]shift[/blue] and [blue]morph[/blue] into writing you are familiar with.
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.options.TAK: [green]Choose a Rare card to add to your deck.[/green] [red]Gain a Curse.[/red]
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.options.REA: [green]Add a random Rare card to your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 2 HP.[/red]
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.options.SKI: [green]Choose a card to add to your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 1 HP.[/red]
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.TAKE.description: You take the book with you. It whispers.
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.READ.description: The words burn into your mind.
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.SKIM.description: You skim the tome for anything useful.
BG_CURSED_TOME.pages.LEAVE.description: Some things are better left unread.
BG_ANCIENT_WRITING.title: Ancient Writing
BG_ANCIENT_WRITING.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
Scaling the city, you notice a wall covered in the writing of [gold]Ancients.[/gold] As you try to wrap your head around what the puzzling symbols and glyphs could mean, the writing begins to [blue]glow.[/blue]
Suddenly, the message becomes clear...
BG_ANCIENT_WRITING.pages.INITIAL.options: [green]Upgrade a starter Strike and a starter Defend.[/green]
BG_AUGMENTER.title: Augmenter
BG_AUGMENTER.pages.INITIAL.description:
A man with an eyepatch and a devilish grin strides up to you.
"Hey there, stranger. Interested in advancing science? I can make you stronger than any training or blessing. You're gonna need it if you're one of those heroes with a death wish."

"Whad'ya say?"
BG_AUGMENTER.pages.DRINK.description: It tastes awful, but it works.
BG_DESIGNER.title: Designer In-Spire
BG_DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.description:
You discover a [green]colorful[/green] shop with the banner "IN-SPIRE" and walk in to see what's inside.
"No, no way. Nope. Can't let you in!"

A man with ridiculous clothing appears at the entrance to bar you.
BG_DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.options.CLEAN_: [gold]3 Gold:[/gold] [green]Remove a card from your deck.[/green]
BG_DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.options.FULL_S: [gold]5 Gold:[/gold] [green]Remove a card and upgrade a card.[/green]
BG_DESIGNER.pages.PUNCH.description: You punch the designer. Their bodyguard punches back.
BG_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.title: The Woman in Blue
BG_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
From the darkness, an arm pulls you into a small shop. As your eyes adjust, you see a pale woman in sharp clothes gesturing towards a wall of potions.
"Buy a potion. Now!" she states.
BG_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.LEAVE.description: As you turn to leave, she slaps you.
BG_OLD_BEGGAR.title: Old Beggar
BG_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.description: An old beggar cloaked in fur reaches his hands out towards you as you pass. "Spare some coin, child?"
BG_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFE: [gold]2 Gold:[/gold] [green]Remove a card from your deck.[/green]
BG_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.OFFER.description: The beggar reveals himself as a cleric, and cleanses your deck.
BG_KNOWING_SKULL.title: Knowing Skull
BG_KNOWING_SKULL.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
You find yourself in an old, decorated chamber. In the center of the room, a large skull sits atop an ornate pedestal. As you approach, the skull [green]bursts into flames[/green] and turns to face you.

"Ask, and I shall answer. You may ask two questions."
BG_KNOWING_SKULL.pages.INITIAL.options.C: [green]Choose a card to add to your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 1 HP.[/red]
[green]Choose a card to add to your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 1 HP.[/red]
BG_A_NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.title: A Note for Yourself
BG_A_NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.INITIAL.des: You spot a loose brick within a pillar that catches your eye.
BG_A_NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.INITIAL.opt: Choose an Ironclad card to add to your deck.
Choose a Silent card to add to your deck.
Choose a Defect card to add to your deck. [green]Obtain Prismatic Shard.[/green]
Choose a Watcher card to add to your deck.
BG_A_NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.TAKE.descri: You learn something from another life.
BG_COLOSSEUM.title: The Colosseum
BG_COLOSSEUM.pages.INITIAL.description:
Thwack!!!
..
......
...
You were knocked unconscious...

Groggy and with a throbbing head, you awaken in the center of a massive stadium, before a roaring crowd of Slavers, Cultists, and other denizens of the City. Warm up the crowd, or be the main event?
BG_NLOTH.title: N'loth
BG_NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.description:
An odd creature with a hunched back sprouting several tentacles is scrounging through a pile of trash and debris in front of you. As you approach, he shuffles towards you in a non-threatening manner.
"N'loth hungry. Feed N'loth."
BG_NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFER_REL: [red]Give a random relic.[/red] [green]Choose a Rare card to add to your deck.[/green]
BG_NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFER_POT: [red]Give a potion.[/red] [green]Add a random Rare card to your deck.[/green]
BG_WE_MEET_AGAIN.title: We Meet Again!
BG_WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
"We meet again!"
A cheery disheveled fellow approaches you gleefully. You do not know this man.

"It's me, [gold]Ranwid![/gold] Have any goods for me today? The usual? A fella like me can't make it alone, you know?"
You eye him suspiciously and consider your options...
BG_WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.INITIAL.options.C: [red]Remove an Uncommon or Rare card from your deck.[/red] [green]Obtain a relic.[/green]
BG_THE_JOUST.title: The Joust
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.description:
As you make your way through the large buildings you come across a long narrow bridge and spot knights on either side, facing one another. You approach...
"Halt!"

A knight forcefully gestures you to stop with its giant lance.
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.options.BET_G: Roll the die: on a [blue]4-6[/blue], [green]win 6 Gold.[/green]
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.options.BET_R: Roll the die: on a [blue]4-6[/blue], [green]win 6 Gold.[/green]
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.options.BET_P: Roll the die: on a [blue]4-6[/blue], [green]win 6 Gold.[/green]
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.WIN.description: Your knight wins! You collect your winnings.
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.LOSE.description: Your knight is knocked off his horse.
BG_THE_JOUST.pages.WATCH.description: You watch the joust. It's quite a show.
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.title: The Mausoleum
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
Venturing through a series of tombs, you are faced with a large sarcophagus studded with gems in the center of a circular room.
You cannot make out the writing on the coffin, however, you do notice [purple]black fog[/purple] seeping out from the sides.
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.options.O: [green]Obtain a relic.[/green] Roll the die: on a [blue]1-3[/blue], [red]gain a Curse.[/red]
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.LUCKY.description: You take the relic and leave quickly.
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.UNLUCKY.descripti: As you take the relic, a black mist seeps out of the coffin.
BG_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.LEAVE.description: Best not to disturb the dead.
BG_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.title: Forgotten Altar
BG_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
In front of you sits an altar to a forgotten god.
Atop the altar sits an ornate female statue with arms outstretched.
She calls out to you, demanding sacrifice.
BG_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.OFFER.descripti: The statue accepts your offering and gives something in return.
BG_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.SACRIFICE.descr: Your blood spills on the altar.
BG_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.DESECRATE.descr: You smash the statue. A dark wail echoes around you.
BG_PURIFIER.title: Purifier
BG_PURIFIER.pages.INITIAL.description: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
BG_PURIFIER.pages.CLEANSE.description: The light burns away your curses.
BG_MIND_BLOOM.title: Mind Bloom
BG_MIND_BLOOM.pages.INITIAL.description:
While walking and traversing through the chaos of the Spire, your thoughts suddenly begin to feel very... [purple]real...[/purple]

Imaginings of [red]monsters[/red] and [gold]riches[/gold] begin to manifest themselves into reality.
The sensation is quickly fleeting. What do you do?
[red]Fight a boss from Act I.[/red] [green]Obtain a relic.[/green]
BG_MIND_BLOOM.pages.HEALTHY.description: You feel healthy, but something is off.
BG_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.title: Tomb of Lord Red Mask
BG_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.pages.INITIAL.d: A highly ornamented tomb can be seen on the other side of a floating path. Upon reaching the tomb, you notice a slot for [gold]gold[/gold] coins with a scratched out inscription above it.
The tomb recognizes the mask and opens its coffers.
BG_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.pages.OFFER_GOL: You leave your gold, and take a relic from the tomb.
BG_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.pages.LEAVE.des: You leave the tomb in peace.
BG_FALLING.title: Falling
BG_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.description:
As you head upwards hopping from one floating shape to another, you slip.

You begin to fall.
BG_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.options.LAND.de: [red]Choose 1 of 3 random cards in your deck to lose.[/red]
BG_FALLING.pages.LAND.description: You land hard, and something slips from your grasp.
BG_SECRET_PORTAL.title: Secret Portal
BG_SECRET_PORTAL.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
Before you is a sight that seems out of place in the alien landscape around you. Strangely placed into one of the living walls of the Beyond is an enclosed stone entrance filled with a [purple]swirling magical portal.[/purple]

You aren't sure where it leads, but maybe it could speed your journey through the Spire.
BG_SECRET_PORTAL.pages.ENTER.description: Your sense of time and space is torn apart.
BG_SECRET_PORTAL.pages.LEAVE.description: Careful seems better. You move on.
BG_WINDING_HALLS.title: Winding Halls
BG_WINDING_HALLS.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
As you slowly make your way up the twisting pathways, you constantly find yourself losing your way as the walls and ground seem to inexplicably shift before your eyes.

The constant [purple]whispering voices[/purple] in the back of your head aren't helping things either.
BG_WINDING_HALLS.pages.EMBRACE.descripti: Madness takes hold, and you learn strange things.
BG_WINDING_HALLS.pages.FOCUS.description: You find your way, but something follows you.
BG_WINDING_HALLS.pages.RETRACE.descripti: You find your way back, exhausted.
BG_SENSORY_STONE.title: Sensory Stone
BG_SENSORY_STONE.pages.INITIAL.descripti: Navigating through the Beyond, you discover a [blue]glowing tesseract[/blue] spinning and shifting gently in the air.
BG_SENSORY_STONE.pages.INITIAL.options.R: [green]Choose a colorless card to add to your deck.[/green]
[green]Choose 2 colorless cards to add to your deck.[/green] [red]Lose 2 HP.[/red]
BG_SENSORY_STONE.pages.RECALL.descriptio: The memories fade, but something stays with you.
BG_THE_MOAI_HEAD.title: The Moai Head
BG_THE_MOAI_HEAD.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
You stumble across something that feels *very* out of place. Before you, an enormous stony head emerges from a large wall segment that does not shift and change like the rest of this area.
The head's mouth is wide open, and it reveals large intimidating teeth stained red with blood. The surface of the statue is riddled with pictographs that seem to indicate people throwing themselves into the mouth of this head and being devoured. Why would anyone do that?
BG_THE_MOAI_HEAD.pages.INITIAL.options.O: [red]Lose a relic.[/red] [green]Gain Gold equal to its price.[/green]
BG_THE_MOAI_HEAD.pages.JUMP.description: You emerge restored, if a little bruised.
BG_THE_MOAI_HEAD.pages.OFFER.description: The head swallows your relic and spits out gold.
BG_FACE_TRADER.title: Face Trader
BG_FACE_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.description:
You walk by an eerie statue holding several masks...
Something behind you softly whispers,
"Stop."
BG_FACE_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.TRA: [green]Obtain a relic,[/green] [red]then give him one of your relics.[/red]
